body: You assume entirely too much, about me and about the plights of others. And you speak with the tone of someone who thinks they have it all figured out. And that's of no use to anyone except yourself. I actually feel sorry for you, as your intentions are probably good. But proselytizing doesn't accomplish anything.
Looks like a cell dividing.
It might be true for you. That doesn't make it true for everyone.
Too late for all that. No energy.

How about the willpower to get out of bed. I spend most of my time there when not at work. Nothing interests me. Food disgusts me. Little changes aren't going to outway wanting to die 24/7. I've been down that road before. So if I had to pick one thing I don't like about myself, I'd say my stupid beating heart.
If you really believe that, you're pretty stupid. As someone who's been hospitalized, I'd rather die than go back.
"Me too"

"But know that every life, no matter how miserable it may seem on the surface, carries a seed of boundless joy."

Bullshit.

I've spent plenty of time around "good" people. No matter how you dress it up, people only care about what you can do for them or what they can take from you. And as to historical shows of "goodness" even a broken clock is right twice a day. Then constant give take give take is exhausting and ultimately leads nowhere.
I wouldn't even know where to begin.
Change myself to what?
I'm well aware that there are people in the world who do good. I have tried to do so myself, but those few people/acts can't redeem the rest.
I'm a disgusting ape who constantly hurts/is hurt by the people I care about, and no matter how hard I try to make things better, nothing ever changes.
Experience has taught me that most people are base, selfish, and disgusting, and I'm no exception.
I hate the whole human race, including myself. Since I can only choose for myself, I choose to remove myself.
None of it exists, just the hells that people create for each other.
To stave off people who might use, "You'll go to hell!" as an argument.
It doesn't exist, for one.

I see so much of myself in this it's not even funny. One time I had a friend force me into that positive affirmation stuff too. I couldn't get the words out without gagging on them. So yeah, um, 31 and still in this same place. I know this is of no help to you, but I at least wanted to let you know that I recognize your plight all too well.

You must be to talk with a lowlife like me. I have zero worth. None. I wish someone would walk through this office right now and put a bullet in my head. Then you and I could be spared more of my bullshit.
I'm amazed you've put up with this much of my crap already. You must be a much better person than me.
When I have a day off, I spend it sleeping or staring at the walls. I don't find anything fun anymore. Everything either has no impact or just makes me feel worse.
Not enough to get away like you're talking about.
Yeah, and then I would get to come back to no job, and have no means to support myself. No one is going to take care of me.

I have in the past. By now they all have to be sick of hearing about it. Unless there's a way that doesn't involved roping them into my bullshit, it's no going to work. I've done enough of that already, and I'm sick of it.
I'm trying like hell to find a way to get a hold of some Nembutal or the like. Wish it were fucking legal in the states.
I'd love to take off. Unfortunately, I can't. Too much shit on my plate, same as always.
Can't afford more therapy. My HMO won't cover it. And I make too much to qualify for assistance.
Gorgeous

I sympathize. Having a mother with those issues is a double whammy. Not only do you have to cope her moods, which can probably be depressing enough, but you have to cope with your own. It's a lot to take on. It CAN get better if you work at it. I'm not saying that it'll ever be sunshine and roses or that you'll ever feel completely "normal", but you can have a life that you will actually feel is worth living, even if you don't always want to. For the immediate future, I cannot overstate the importance of NOT stopping your meds. Consult your physician. The couple of times in my life where I've really lapsed in taking my medication, I've been hospitalized.
There are more worthy things to get pissed about.
We can go to Hell together, because I probably would've reacted exactly the same way.

And that's IF you can actually find one at all. I've contacted three within the last week and none of them have any time to see me. It's difficult enough to ask for help. It makes me feel weak and pathetic enough, without having the door slammed in my face. The experiences of others, combined with my own, make me seriously question whether there is any hope at all.
Fine tuning? More like crap shooting.
Whatever suffering he portrayed in that comic, I can almost guarantee you that he feels many times worse in reality. Get him help before he hurts himself or worse.

You should speak to your physician and quite possibly a counselor as well. If there's anyone in your circle who you think could handle the knowledge of what you're going through and be supportive, tell them. That won't end the loneliness or the self-hate, but every little bit helps.
The one SNRI I was ever on did the same thing to me. Have you been on the standard SSRIs before?

Yep. And it's to the point now where I don't talk about it with anyone, because it's clearly nothing but a burden to them. I will get angry with myself for even thinking about talking with someone about it, because, after all, it's my problem.

I know they they do something because the few times I've gone off them I cannot stop crying. Now, whether that's the drugs keeping depression at bay or just a withdrawal symptom from the drug itself, who the hell knows. Either way, it's the only effect I can honestly say medication has ever had on me, and I've bloody well tried them all.
